acceptance.performance: at least 10 percent end-to-end output-throughput gain versus matched control

current_evidence.note: Paper high-batch results are not transferable to the frozen concurrency-16 contract without target evidence.

terminal_result.reason: At the frozen concurrency-16 point, the complete recurrent operator is less than one quarter of the share required for the paper's best local speedup to yield 1.10x. Perfect deletion of the operator also remains below target.

next_actions: Do not implement or rerun DeltaLog unchanged for the frozen concurrency-16 objective.
Activate When Good Enough Is Optimal as the next paper.
Reopen DeltaLog only for a separately frozen high-batch deployment whose target trace proves a materially larger state-materialization share.
